description: MariaDB topology and options: version, replicas, replication mode (incl. Galera), proxies.

fields.description: Server LTS series; packages come from the mariadb_repo_setup repository.
fields.name: version
fields.title: MariaDB version

fields.description: Secondary servers behind the primary; not used in Galera mode, where the cluster is sized by galera_nodes instead.
fields.name: replicas
fields.title: Replicas

fields.description: async/semi_sync = one primary with standard MariaDB replication; galera = a synchronous multi-master Galera cluster with no distinguished primary.
fields.name: replication
fields.title: Replication mode

fields.description: Size of the Galera cluster; odd only, minimum 3 — quorum needs a strict majority of the last known membership.
fields.name: galera_nodes
fields.title: Galera nodes

fields.description: ProxySQL instances in front of the cluster; mutually exclusive with MaxScale.
fields.name: proxysql
fields.title: ProxySQL nodes

fields.description: Run MariaDB MaxScale (25.10 line) as the router instead of ProxySQL: read/write split and Galera monitoring out of the box.
fields.name: maxscale
fields.title: MaxScale

fields.description: SQL executed on the primary (or the first Galera node) once the server is up, before the workload.
fields.name: init_sql
fields.title: Init SQL

rules.message: Galera has no replicas: size the cluster with galera_nodes
semi-synchronous replication needs at least one replica
pick one router: MaxScale or ProxySQL, not both
ProxySQL in front of a single server only adds a hop
